source: &1084 Oh...you found him.
target: &1084 哦……你找到他了。

source: &1475 Apparently, this is what Central wanted me to see.
target: &1475 看来，中枢就是想让我看这个。

source: &1476 Why would it do this?
target: &1476 它为什么要这么做？

source: &1477 I stopped him!
target: &1477 我已经阻止他了！

source: &1085 Charlie...
&1478 I promised him I could help!

source: &1479 And then they...IT did this to him...
target: &1479 然后他们……它就这样对待他……

source: &1086 Maybe it's trying to hammer home the message.
target: &1086 也许它是想让你记牢这次的教训。

source: &1087 After all, Central didn't ask you to talk him out of it.
target: &1087 毕竟，中枢没叫你劝他回头。

source: &1088 It said 'neutralize.'
target: &1088 它说的是“消除威胁”。

source: &1480 Why would it be so...?
target: &1480 它怎么能这么……？

source: &94 Doctor Regis.
target: &94 里吉斯博士。

source: &1481 You...soulless, callous...
target: &1481 你这……没有灵魂、冷血无情的……

source: &1482 I PROMISED HIM -
target: &1482 我答应过他——

source: &95 His euthanasia was a necessary measure.
target: &95 对他实施安乐死，是必要的措施。

source: &96 75 percent of the captured bombers have attempted self-immolation in custody.
target: &96 被捕的炸弹客中，有百分之七十五曾在羁押期间试图自爆。

source: &97 The risk of repeating such an action was unacceptable.
target: &97 我们不能接受这种行为再次发生的风险。

source: &1483 He wouldn't have...
&98 Whatever the case may have been,
target: &98 无论事实如何，

source: &99 CEL Command Offices are now safe from -
target: &99 CEL指挥部现已不再受到——

source: &1484 What's left of him, anyway.
target: &1484 至少，他剩下的那些部分不会了。

source: &1089 Charlie...there was nothing we could do...
target: &1089 查理……我们也无能为力……

source: &1090 He was endangering lives.
target: &1090 他危及了别人的生命。

source: &1485 We should have done BETTER, though.
target: &1485 可我们本该做得更好。

source: &1486 He deserved better.
target: &1486 他不该落得这个下场。

source: &1091 He was a brainwashed militant.
target: &1091 他是个被洗脑的武装分子。

source: &1092 And I shot him. It's my responsibility.
target: &1092 而且，是我开的枪。责任在我。

source: &1487 I'm your superior. I made the call. It's all on me.
target: &1487 我是你的上级，决定是我做的。全都该由我负责。

source: &1488 Very good shot, by the way.
target: &1488 顺便说一句，那一枪打得很准。

source: &1489 You probably saved my life with it.
target: &1489 你大概救了我一命。

source: &100 A most satisfactory performance, Dr Regis.
target: &100 表现十分令人满意，里吉斯博士。

source: &101 I have assimilated Dr Lao's report.
target: &101 我已读取劳博士的报告。

source: &102 No further lives were put at risk.
target: &102 未有更多人的生命受到威胁。

source: &103 You will of course remember confidentiality protocol.
target: &103 当然，你应当记得保密规定。

source: &104 Discussion of this event outside CEL brings severe penalties.
target: &104 在CEL以外谈论此次事件，将受到严厉惩处。

source: &1490 As usual.
&105 I'm sure you understand, to protect the safety of -
target: &105 我相信你能理解，这是为了保障——

source: &1491 What's left, anyway.
target: &1491 反正，也只剩这些了。

source: &1093 I'm amazed there was that much to find.
target: &1093 能找到这么多，我都很惊讶。

source: &1094 I think Central was blowing its top when I sent it the report.
target: &1094 我把报告发过去的时候，中枢大概气炸了。

source: &1492 I should have done better, Max.
target: &1492 我本该做得更好，麦克斯。

source: &1095 He was a brainwashed fundamentalist.
target: &1095 他是个被洗脑的原教旨主义者。

source: &1096 And you're lucky you got out alive.
target: &1096 你能活着出来，已经很幸运了。

source: &1097 It's a miracle nobody else was hurt.
target: &1097 没有其他人受伤，简直是个奇迹。

source: &1493 He was a dud.
target: &1493 他是个哑弹。

source: &1494 Whoever engineered him did a terrible job.
target: &1494 给他做改造的人，手艺糟透了。

source: &1495 It's why there are such big pieces of him left.
target: &1495 所以他的身体还能剩下这么大的碎块。

source: &1098 And now you're trying to make peace with those parts?
target: &1098 而你现在想和这些碎块和解？

source: &1496 I feel like he could have been more.
target: &1496 我总觉得，他的人生本可以不止于此。

source: &1497 He was a human being, Max.
target: &1497 他也是个人，麦克斯。

source: &106 Dr Regis. I have been analysing today's engagement.
target: &106 里吉斯博士。我一直在分析今天的交锋。

source: &107 Dr Lao has been overly generous in her report.
target: &107 劳博士的报告对你过于宽容。

source: &108 It is unsettlingly obvious that it should have been resolved more appropriately.
target: &108 显而易见，此事原本应当得到更妥善的解决，这令人不安。

source: &109 It is fortunate for yourself and the city that his detonation was not wholly successful.
target: &109 对你和这座城市而言，幸运的是，他的爆炸并未完全成功。

source: &110 Pending an investigation of your actions today -
target: &110 在调查你今天的行动期间——

&111  - aaaayyyyyy -
target: &111  - aaaayyyyyy -

source: &113 General alarm, general alarm. Central functions compromised.
target: &113 紧急警报，紧急警报。中枢功能受损。

source: &114 Localised E-War attack detected within heuristic barrier systems.
target: &114 在启发式屏障系统内部，检测到局部电子战攻击。

source: &115 Systems entering siege mode. All personnel equipped for abstract-dynamic countermeasures,
target: &115 系统进入围城模式。所有具备抽象动态反制能力的人员，

source: &116 please report to action stations. Repeat, abstract-dynamics to action stations.
target: &116 请前往战斗岗位。重复，抽象动态人员前往战斗岗位。

source: &1100 Sounds like I'm needed.
target: &1100 看来轮到我上场了。

source: &1102 Remember - I'm here if YOU need me, too.
target: &1102 别忘了，你需要我的时候，我也会在。

source: &1103 Remember - no matter what Central says, you've done a great job today.
target: &1103 记住，不管中枢怎么说，你今天都干得很出色。

source: &426 The reports tell you that he was euthanised shortly after being taken into custody. Despite assurances that his death was a product of Central's caution, you can't help but perceive it as a spiteful show of power.
target: &426 报告显示，他在被羁押后不久就遭到了安乐死。尽管报告声称，他的死是中枢谨慎行事的结果，你却无法不觉得，这是一场恶意的权力示威。

source: &427 Despite Max's assurances, you can't help but wonder if there could have been a better end to this. Central's enthusiastic congratulations do nothing to help your feelings on the matter.
target: &427 尽管麦克斯安慰了你，你仍忍不住想，事情是否本可以有更好的结局。中枢热情的祝贺，丝毫没有让你感觉好些。

source: &428 Having seen this young man's end from so close, you're reminded of a life you left long ago...
target: &428 如此近距离地见到这个年轻人的结局，让你想起了很久以前抛下的那种生活……

source: &429 You've never personally performed an autopsy, but you're sure that you'd need more than your bare hands.
target: &429 你从未亲自做过尸检，但你确定，光靠一双手肯定不够。

source: &430 The three heavy-duty polymer bags containing his remains have been sealed shut following the coroner's report.
target: &430 装着他遗骸的三个高强度聚合物袋，在验尸官出具报告后已经封好。

source: &431 Better not. If you start pouring heating gel all over the remaining volatile bones, you're likely to end up triggering an explosion.
target: &431 还是别了。要是把烹饪凝胶倒在那些仍不稳定的骨头上，很可能会引发爆炸。

source: &432 You think for a moment, then decide against searching again. Anything else in there that could be learned would be better left to the coroner.
target: &432 你想了想，决定不再翻找。里面若还有什么值得了解的，还是留给验尸官处理更好。

source: &1499 Why would I want to harm him any more?
target: &1499 我为什么还要继续伤害他？

source: &433 The body has not had a great deal of examination, you suppose they're being careful about the potentially volatile nature of parts of his body. You make a slice along his thigh, and pull his femur loose.
target: &433 尸体还没经过太多检查，你猜他们是担心某些部位仍有爆炸风险。你沿着大腿切开一道口子，取出他的股骨。

source: &434 Most of the examination has been kept to the head, where the shot was made. You make a slice along his thigh, and pull his femur loose.
target: &434 检查主要集中在中弹的头部。你沿着大腿切开一道口子，取出他的股骨。

source: &435 Making a slice into one of the bags, you remove a femur that survived the blast, mostly intact.
target: &435 你划开其中一个袋子，取出一根在爆炸中幸存、基本完好的股骨。

source: &436 The door leads back out into this wing of the Case-Specialists Office.
target: &436 门外是办案专员办公室这一翼的走廊。

source: &339 A flickering blue projection of a skeleton. From what you remember of school, you can tell that some of the bones shouldn't be shaped like that.
target: &339 蓝色的骨骼投影忽明忽暗。凭着上学时学过的一点知识，你也能看出，有些骨头不该长成那个样子。

source: &1500 They've holomapped his bone-structure.
target: &1500 他们给他的骨骼结构做了全息建模。

source: &1501 Years of gene-tampering left this kid's bones weakened and warped all around his body.
target: &1501 多年的基因改造，让这孩子全身的骨头都变得脆弱、畸形。

source: &340 The projection continues to flicker. Apparently, your drone has no way to engage with it.
target: &340 投影仍在闪烁。看来，你的无人机没法和它交互。

source: &1502 It's a volumetric hologram. Even *I* know I can't actually grab it.
target: &1502 这是立体全息影像。连我都知道，根本抓不住它。

source: &342 A good thing Guy's breach wasn't into that drone built into the ceiling, otherwise you wouldn't get very far.
target: &342 幸好盖伊侵入的不是那台固定在天花板上的无人机，不然你可走不了多远。

source: &1503 They've been using drones like that for auto or telepresence surgery since I was a kid.
target: &1503 我小时候，他们就用这种无人机做自动手术或远程手术了。

source: &1504 Looks like it's finished with the autopsy.
target: &1504 看来尸检已经做完了。

source: &346 It's powered down - apparently the utility drone you inhabit can't communicate with it.
target: &346 它已经关机，看来你附身的作业无人机无法和它通信。

source: &1505 It's operated by Central. There isn't anything I can do with it.
target: &1505 它由中枢操控。我拿它没办法。

source: &347 Screens full of medical data. Even if the drone's optics had a high enough resolution for you to read them, you're certain they'd make no sense to you.
target: &347 屏幕上满是医学数据。就算无人机的光学系统分辨率够高，让你读清上面的内容，你肯定也看不懂。

source: &1506 The x-ray shows I was right. He had the spinal brace for scoliosis.
target: &1506 X光片证明我没猜错。他戴的是矫正脊柱侧弯的支具。

source: &1507 It's a symptom of the genetic adjustments made to his bones.
target: &1507 这是骨骼基因改造带来的症状。

source: &1508 It's already been compiled for the report.
target: &1508 它已经整理进报告里了。

source: &1509 Apparently the high quantities of explosives in his bones was giving him joint problems.
target: &1509 看来，骨头里大量的爆炸物让他的关节出了问题。

source: &1510 Poor kid must've been in a lot of pain...
target: &1510 可怜的孩子，一定疼得厉害……
